# API golden corpus: one request per line, replayed through the Ruby app by go/scripts/api_golden.rb and through the
# Go handler by TestGoldenAPI. Format: METHOD PATH [| Header: value]...
#
# Date tokens expand against the fixture as the script seeds it: {today}, {tomorrow}, {latest} (latest business
# day), {sunday} (latest Sunday), {bday:N} (Fixtures.business_day(N)), {ago:N} (latest business day minus N days).
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Append new requests; regenerate the golden file afterwards.
